conditions: The package version is exactly v4.5.2.

This is a fix-version claim: the described allocation amplification affects the v4 line before v4.5.2 (and separately v3 through 3.2.2, and v5 before 5.2.2), and is not present starting with this version.
summary: golang-jwt/jwt v4 before v4.5.2 allows excessive memory allocation in Parser.ParseUnverified: it calls strings.Split on fully untrusted input, so a token consisting of Bearer followed by many period characters causes O(n) byte allocations (CWE-405, GHSA-mh63-6h87-95cp / CVE-2025-30204). Fixed in v4.5.2 via a bounded strings.Cut-based splitToken helper that rejects inputs with more than two delimiters instead of allocating a slice for all of them.
